integrity: Two standalone Python 3 standard-library programs checked the complete 120-state Boolean-relation certificate and independently enumerated rings through length sixteen. All results are included, not external dependencies.
scientific_limitations: Indexed binary rings and exactly one majority-rule update only; does not count multistep images or attractors. The 1988 cylindrical-automata article was only accessible as an abstract. No independent human mathematical validation has been performed.
title: Exact cyclic image counts and spectral growth for elementary majority cellular automaton Rule 232
